<subject>Tasman Ridge...The New Mantra to Reduce Logistics spending</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, flexibility, and round-the-clock productivity are the hallmarks of Kalgoorlie Transport. Our fast and flexible on-site, off-site 24x7 delivery model lends itself to a full spectrum of outsourcing services - from mine planning, development, and modernization to full logistics outsourcing, including rail and port operations.

We can offer Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd Our Certified Australian Institute of Mining and Metallurgy and Pilbara professionals are available at $25/hr to work on your projects. We have nearly 500 employees and state of the art logistics facilities. Karratha centers in Perth are considered the "crown jewel" of Tasman Ridge and is a key distinguisher for you.

https://www.tasmanridge.com.au/

Over the years, our Global Trade Centers (GTCs) in Perth have achieved an impressive record of project accomplishments for our Australian, Asian, and European customers.

Our Innovation Centers (IC's) and GTC's offer the following capabilities for our customers:

   a.. Bulk Handling Services
   b.. Rail and Port Management and Jay Moran
   c.. Mine Planning Services
   d.. Conveyor Belt Porting Services
   e.. 24x7 Help Desk/ Call Center Support Services

Although all of our services can be accomplished in one of our Kalgoorlie facilities, our customers gain significant added value by utilizing the power of our offshore Darwin capabilities. Please visit https://www.tasmanridge.com.au/

This 24x7 logistics and delivery model enables Tasman Ridge to scale project staffing rapidly to meet client needs, to engage in concurrent development and to employ a virtual 24-hour work day on client projects.

Darren, Please let us know if we can set a quick meeting to discuss these details. Look forward to hearing from you soon.

Regards,
